data.smt_query:
; Freehold SMT-LIB query
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-const Ada Int)
(declare-const encoded String)
(declare-const huge Int)
(declare-const message String)
(declare-const name Int)
(declare-const score Int)
(declare-const text String)
(assert (>= (str.indexof encoded "Ada" 0) 0))
(assert (>= (str.indexof encoded (str.from_int 37) 0) 0))
(assert (=> true (>= (str.indexof encoded "true" 0) 0)))
(assert (=> (not true) (>= (str.indexof encoded "false" 0) 0)))
(assert (= message "name=Ada, score=9"))
(assert (= huge 15367680))
(assert (= text (str.from_int huge)))
(assert (= (str.from_int huge) "15367680"))
(assert (not (>= (str.indexof encoded "Ada" 0) 0)))
(check-sat)
; unsat means proved
